scope: Predeclared computational reproducibility budgets, not calibrated clinical or population-wide equivalence limits

rationale.probabilities_information_SD: Four-decimal absolute probability, per-item information and posterior-SD resolution
rationale.theta: One thousandth of the fixed unit latent SD
rationale.loglik: Five-decimal marginal log-likelihood resolution; AIC/BIC inherit twice this budget at equal N/k
rationale.SEM: One thousandth relative error on the declared reporting range; undefined central SEM blocks comparison
rationale.range: All traces retained; reporting acceptance evaluated at theta in [-4,4], matching the existing UI range
rationale.identity: Existing sqrt(machine epsilon) algebra-only identity rule inherited from PR65/72
